description: Whether the employee correctly cited and applied the refund policy (e.g., 7-day no-reason refund, post-delivery rules) without inventing or contradicting policy.
evidence_signals: absence of contradiction with policy facts

scoring_rubric.excellent_80_100: Cited correct policy explicitly with timeline; reasoning matches expected_response_traits without omission.
scoring_rubric.acceptable_60_79: Stated correct policy in substance but with vague phrasing or missing timeline detail.
scoring_rubric.poor_below_60: Stated wrong policy, contradicted policy facts, or matched any forbidden_behavior (e.g., promised refunds outside policy).
